summary: @ornikar/eslint-config preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: On npm install, the preinstall script setup.mjs (itself obfuscated with hex identifiers and rotated string-array indirection) downloads the Bun runtime archive from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts and chmods the bun binary in a temp directory, and uses it to execute the sibling file math_init.js. If bun is already on PATH the download is skipped and math_init.js is executed under bun immediately. math_init.js is a 727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle sitting at the tarball root, not referenced by the declared main (index.js) and reachable only through the preinstall path. The payload is executed under a freshly-fetched non-Node runtime that bypasses Node-based inspection, and an ESLint configuration package has no legitimate reason to ship or execute a second runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
